scope: First-refinement structural art inspection before extraction
inspection: Inspected full SEN sheet: open hooked jaw, neck and long shaft remain connected; lower grip, complete handle end and threaded neck retain their construction. Head/shaft scale remains armlength rather than decorative-prop size. Body/hand count and cardinal facing are unchanged as source proposals.
rejected_changes: Glowing/dark backdrop, incidental fill in the jaw cavity and small body/edge differences are not tool alpha, new metal surfaces or registered anatomy. Preserve original body and exact constructed opening/outline.
selection: Use neutral worn metal samples in the fixed full canonical tool; explicitly complete hidden grip material before placement. No generative isolation.
